event.label: Last listed in the directories transcribed so far (1935)

body.p: Barkly Place is a lane off the west side of Bouverie Street, beside the Palmerston Hotel. In 1878 the directory lists the turn into Barkly Place between the hotel at No. 97 and McLean's foundry.
It is first listed in the directories in 1878 and last in 1935. It had between four and thirteen listings in each directory.

div.head: Along the street
div.p: From 1910 the directories give its corner with Bouverie Street as its only crossing.

list.item: M. Walker's ice cream factory at No. 16 (1920).
Florant and Co., leadlight and later skylight manufacturers, at No. 39 (1920 to 1935).

div.head: Records
div.p: Every directory and electoral-roll listing for Barkly Place can be browsed in search. Each directory year links to its own page from Sands & McDougall Directories.
